home.intro: This is a simple app demonstrating a combination of tools & technologies. All pages have sound effects.
home.instructions: Click 'Frisbee Game' to begin. You will be led to Crash Site through narrative interaction.

frisbee.title: Space Frisbee
frisbee.instruction: Click the frisbee to throw it!

prompt.question: What should we do?
choices: It could be dangerous, we should be careful.
Let's reach in and find out!

lopQuestion.subText: It ate it all, and now all we have is this wet spoon! What do we do now?

lopResponse1.subText: Yeah! I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

lopResponse2.subText: Wait! It could be dangerous, I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

lopResponse3.subText: It could be hurt! We have to help! I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

warp.subText: That's not just wet, there's saliva on that spoon. We can learn so much from that!

lopHelp.subText: Cellina, the Genehome guide, you think you can help us?

cellinaSaliva.subText: Of course, saliva has cells in it!

cellinaCells.subText: Here’s what I know. Cells make up all living things. They are like tiny building blocks that help organisms grow, survive, and function.

cellinaExamineCells.subText: We can use that saliva to take a closer look at the cells of what is in that rocket!

lopExamineSpoon.subText: I just see the saliva, how can we see the cells?

cellinaExamineSpoon.subText: Microscopes help us see small things, give me a minute.

cellinaMicroscope.subText: WAIT! We need to transfer the saliva to a microscope slide.

level1-008quiz.speech1-lop: Wait, is there an organelle only animal cells have?

prompt1.prompt: Animal cells have a ________________ that plant cells do not have.
responses: Animal cells have a lysosome that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a mitochondria that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a chloroplast that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a nucleus that plant cells do not have.

level1-008quiz.speech2-lop: So are there any organelles only plant cells have?

prompt2.prompt: Plant cells have _______ and _________ that animal cells do not have. (Choose 2)
responses: Yes, plant cells have ${a} and ${b} that animal cells do not have.
